summaries.name: Strava
summaries.summary: Strava is an online route-planning tool for finding popular cycling routes in a given area. It also integrates with dedicated bike computers and GPS devices for performance tracking.

summaries.name: Ride with GPS
summaries.summary: Ride with GPS is an online route-planning tool for finding popular cycling routes in a given area.

summaries.name: MapMyRide
summaries.summary: MapMyRide is an online route-planning tool for finding popular cycling routes in a given area.

summaries.name: Garmin Edge series
summaries.summary: Garmin Edge series is a line of dedicated bike computers/GPS devices from Garmin, offering GPS navigation, heart rate monitoring, and performance tracking.

summaries.name: Wahoo Elemnt series
summaries.summary: Wahoo Elemnt series is a line of dedicated bike computers/GPS devices from Wahoo, offering GPS navigation, heart rate monitoring, and integration with popular cycling apps.

summaries.name: Lezyne Super GPS
summaries.summary: Lezyne Super GPS is a compact, affordable dedicated bike GPS device offering GPS navigation, heart rate monitoring, and customizable data screens.

summaries.name: Training Peaks
summaries.summary: Training Peaks is a cycling app that dedicated bike computers/GPS devices can integrate with for performance tracking.

summaries.name: Lifeproof
summaries.summary: Lifeproof makes protective phone cases designed for cycling use.

summaries.name: Quad Lock
summaries.summary: Quad Lock makes protective phone cases and universal phone mounts that attach to bike handlebars or stems.

summaries.name: Rokform
summaries.summary: Rokform makes universal phone mounts that attach to bike handlebars or stems.

summaries.name: Aquapac
summaries.summary: Aquapac makes weather-resistant phone pouches that protect phones from the elements while cycling.
